title: Connexions projectives et uniformisation : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: S is a base scheme. P is a Brauer–Severi scheme of relative dimension r with a section σ. The previous page showed that a section reduces the structure group PGL(r+1) to the affine group Aff(r) = GL(r)·E^r. That subgroup lifts canonically to GL(r+1) as the block matrices (A C; 0 1).

First statement on this page: the functor sending an extension 0 → Ω → E → O_S → 0 to the pair (P(E), σ) is an equivalence of categories. Here Ω is locally free of rank r. P(E) uses Grothendieck's convention: Proj Sym E, whose points are invertible quotients of E. The section σ is the point given by the quotient p: E → O_S.

Why this holds:
- The lift of Aff(r) to GL(r+1) shows that the Brauer class of P vanishes once a section exists.
- P is then P(E) for a bundle E carrying a distinguished quotient E → σ*O_P(1).
- Normalising that quotient to O_S fixes E up to unique isomorphism. The usual twist ambiguity E ⊗ M is killed, because M ≅ σ*O(1) ⊗ σ*O(1)^{-1} = O_S.
- So automorphisms of (P, σ) lift uniquely to automorphisms of E that are the identity on the O_S quotient.
- For this to be an equivalence, Ω must be allowed to vary. Morphisms are isomorphisms of extensions that induce the identity on O_S.

Second statement, unfinished: the infinitesimal neighbourhoods O_P/J^{n+1} of σ(S) are to be identified, as augmented O_S-algebras, with something built from Sym^n(…). The text breaks off at 'Sym^n ('.

What is correct: the conormal bundle J/J^2 is canonically Ω. The degree-one sections of Ω ⊂ E vanish on σ, and σ*O(1) = O_S. Hence gr_J O_P ≅ Sym(Ω).

The point of this preparation: the next page passes to the formal completion P^ of P along σ. In the split case it computes P^ = V(Ω)^ = Spf of the completed Sym(Ω). It also computes the action of Ω = Hom(O_S, Ω) by translations u_a of the extension. This acts on the formal neighbourhood by φ ↦ φ/(1+φ(a)), i.e. Möbius maps tangent to the identity.

Purpose (from the title): a projective connection or projective structure on a curve X, with Ω = Ω^1_X, should be read as an identification of the formal neighbourhood of the diagonal in X×X with the formal neighbourhood of σ in a P^1-bundle P(E). That identification is the route to uniformization.
errors: As an equivalence 'of categories' the statement needs the right morphisms: the kernel Ω must vary (or isomorphisms on Ω be allowed), and morphisms must be required to induce the identity on the quotient O_S. Otherwise the lift from Aut(P,σ) to Aut(E) is only defined up to a unit. This is not wrong, just implicit.

The final claim is cut off. If it was meant to be an identification of O_P/J^{n+1} with the truncated symmetric algebra Sym^{≤n}(Ω), that is false for a non-split extension. In local coordinates the transition functions are t ↦ t/(1+at), not linear. Already at n=2 the obstruction to O_P/J^3 ≅ Sym^{≤2}Ω/… lies in H^1(Hom(Ω, Sym^2 Ω)); for r=1 it is essentially the extension class in H^1(Ω). The identification with Sym(Ω) holds only for the associated graded, or in the split case. The next page indeed restricts to the split ('canonique'/trivial) case before writing P^ = V(Ω)^.

ideas.what: Brauer–Severi scheme with a section ⇔ projective bundle P(E) of an extension of O_S by a locally free Ω; equivalence of categories (P,σ) ↔ (0→Ω→E→O_S→0)
ideas.modern_name: Reduction of PGL(r+1)-torsors to the parabolic/affine subgroup; projective bundle with a section = extension of the tautological quotient
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore (Grothendieck's Brauer group theory; standard in the theory of opers and projective structures)
ideas.where_published: Ingredients in EGA II §4 (P(E)) and Le groupe de Brauer I; the explicit equivalence is not known to me in print

ideas.what: Conormal of the section σ(S) ⊂ P(E) is Ω, and the jets O_P/J^{n+1} are described via symmetric powers
ideas.modern_name: Infinitesimal neighbourhoods of a section; gr_J O_P ≅ Sym(Ω)
ideas.where_published: EGA IV §16 (normal invariants, infinitesimal neighbourhoods) in general form

ideas.what: Preparation for describing projective connections/structures on curves via the formal neighbourhood of a section of a P^1-bundle, compared with the formal neighbourhood of the diagonal

deep.surprise_reason: This is a short, standard set-up page: the dictionary between extensions and P(E) with a section, plus the start of an infinitesimal-neighbourhood computation that is left unfinished. It contains nothing beyond well-known material on projective bundles and opers.
transcription_corrections: The small interlinear insertion above 'foncteur' is illegible. It may be 'contra[variant]' or similar; keep it as [?].
'le quotient {+[?]+} /O_S de E': the insertion above the slash looks like a short word ('vers'?). The sense is 'the quotient E → O_S'.
's'identifient [-...-] O_S-algèbres augmentées' should most likely read 's'identifient [-aux-] comme O_S-algèbres augmentées' or similar; the crossed-out word sits at the end of the line.
The last line is 'Sym^n (' with the argument not written. Read it as an unfinished formula, possibly Sym^{≤n} or Sym^n(E).
